- M4 (X+catS↔P+cat reverse direction enhanced by P)

- M5's catP intermediate effects

Also, using low catalyst + high substrate will probe substrate-order effects:
- M7, M16 (second-order S): rate super-linear in [S]
- M11 (S-induced deactivation): loss of activity at high [S]

I'll choose moderate-high substrate with added product and moderate catalyst—this simultaneously tests product inhibition (M12, M17), substrate saturation (M7, M16, M11), and keeps catalyst in a regime where dimerization matters less (to avoid redundancy with iter 2).
